data.recipe: identical to the official qwen round-one run
data.subsample_method: stratified_subsample by orders.csv scenario_type population shares, seeded shuffle
data.known_contamination_disclosure: 2 of 12 current edge-holdout prompts (SYNEDGE-T-INF-T2/T2, SYNEDGE-T-INF-T11/T11) are verbatim in the round1 edge TRAIN set; affects qwen r1's saved edge_holdout metric identically; edge_holdout is therefore reported both as all-12 and clean-10 for every model; final_boundary_holdout / boundary_stress / main holdouts have zero overlap (verified 2026-07-19)

rendering.method: tokenizer.apply_chat_template on {system, user, assistant} exactly as in finetune_lora.to_text
rendering.alignment_gate: training render vs generation render vs gguf-embedded template must pass src/experiments/cross_model/template_check.py BEFORE training
rendering.loss_masking: unsloth train_on_responses_only with model-specific instruction/response markers, markers must occur exactly once per turn (checked by the gate)
rendering.thinking_policy: non-thinking arms only; a model that cannot disable reasoning is excluded from the primary comparison

lora.targets_policy: functionally-equivalent attention+MLP projection set per model (q,k,v,o,gate,up,down equivalents); trainable counts must match the feasibility-validated number and be published

training.stack: unsloth 2026.7.2 + transformers 5.5.0 + trl 0.24.0 + peft 0.19.1 + torch 2.10.0+cu130 (main .venv), same as the qwen reference runs
training.per_device_batch_size_policy: identical to qwen (8) whenever the model fits natively under the actual unsloth training stack (max_memory_reserved < physical 24 GiB, verified by a smoke run before launch); if it does not fit, use the largest native-fit per-device batch with gradient accumulation adjusted to keep effective batch 16, and disclose the deviation; deliberate sysmem spill is never an accepted training configuration
training.no_per_model_tuning: no hyperparameter changes per model in round one

decoding.hf_runtime: greedy, max_new_tokens 200, enable_thinking=False where the template defines it
decoding.gguf_runtime: llama-cpp-python 0.3.34, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 200, template embedded in the gguf (deployment default must be non-thinking)

conversion.converter: llama.cpp e3546c7948e3af463d0b401e6421d5a4c2faf565 (the commit vendored by the 0.3.34 runtime)
conversion.qwen_specific: --no-mtp required (merged causal-lm checkpoints drop MTP tensors but keep the config key) and unsloth-style non-thinking-default chat template must be embedded

evaluation.pipeline: src/experiments/eval_finetune.py (hf) and src/experiments/gguf_fix/eval_gguf.py (quantized), sets loaded by the same code path

acceptance_criteria_pre_registered.2_no_decision_regression: main_holdout decision agreement per stage >= the same model's OWN base checkpoint
acceptance_criteria_pre_registered.3_offer_improvement: per-stage mean abs offer deviation strictly better than the same model's base
acceptance_criteria_pre_registered.5_final_boundary_required_condition: >= 9/12 correct in EACH class (below/at/above), never aggregated

granite_instantiation.smoke_native_fit: peak 9.3 GiB allocated / 16.9 GiB reserved at batch 8 x accum 2 seq 1024 (native fit, no spill)
granite_instantiation.stack_observations_vs_qwen: unsloth auto-enabled padding-free batching and removed a duplicated BOS for granite; both are loss-equivalent packing/tokenization corrections applied by the shared stack, disclosed for completeness
